patch_list: Block startup ads, banners and interstitials
Blocks automatic app-open ads, display ads in app screens, interstitials, and client-side VAST prerolls.
Gives channel cards one translucent surface, more legible labels, and a simpler loading indicator.
Opens the television section directly when the startup menu contains the TV, RadioHub, and GeoSky cards.
